notes.title: Update 001 - New Mode/Levels added + more!
notes.content:
So - just a little update to say thanks for all your feedback!

Update 001 Notes:

#1 - Added new ‘Rush’ option with 9 new 'small' levels for quicker games 
#2 - Added energy-award on enemy-destroyed for gameplay balance
#3 - Changed large-walls to match small-walls for easier differentiation
#4 - Made ‘Skirmish’ level-generator quicker to unlock for improved access

(see Main Menu for new 'Rush' levels)

notes.title: Day 1 Patch Released!
notes.content:
UPDATE: Patch released.

Fixed: sticking enemy isses
Added: exit option on Pause
Added: range-circles to towers on build/upgrade


Hi All,

Thanks for the great feedback - and also some bug reports - We're working on a patch now and hope to have it rolled out in the next few hours!
Thanks once again for all the positivity - it really makes this worth while!

SHOKIZM
